Class Model

java.lang.Object
smile.onnx.genai.Model
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class Model extends Object implements AutoCloseable
An ONNX Runtime GenAI model. Outlives tokenizers and generators created from it.

    • open

      public static Model open(Path modelDir)
      Opens a model with an accelerator cascade, then CPU.

      Default SMILE_ONNX_GENAI_PROVIDER=auto order: CUDA → RyzenAI → OpenVINO NPU → QNN → DirectML (Windows) → CPU (of(String)). Each accelerator is attempted only when matching EP natives are present; Java failures fall through to the next candidate.

      Classical Vitis AI for general ONNX is SessionOptions.appendVitisAiExecutionProvider(), not part of this GenAI cascade.

      Parameters:
      modelDir - GenAI model directory.
      Returns:
      a new model owned by the caller.
